verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents its own API with more than 120 actions for programmatic domain, DNS, order and account management, including bulk changes, so the product can be driven without its UI. There is no evidence of a CLI, CI integration guidance, or non-interactive auth/token setup, and no OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), so CI use is only implied. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline documentation, API key/auth docs for unattended use, machine-readable API spec, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities. Our API supports more than 120 actions
Build your account by registering, transferring, and renewing domains through commands. You can even delete and push domains through our API.
If you're looking to make large bulk adjustments to your account or domains, our API makes the process quick, efficient, and accurate.
